subject: Marketplace plugin partner integration: in-app Redwood runtime & commercial model
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlasworks.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exploring an in-app plugin for AtlasWorks marketplace

Hi Karthik & Lauren,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. AtlasWorks is exploring a lightweight, in-app plugin model for our marketplace where partners can surface AI features directly inside our customers' admin consoles. We've been evaluating options for an embeddable runtime (sandboxed, tenant-aware) and your team was flagged for both runtime performance and commercial flexibility.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a packaged plugin (JS wrapper + runtime API) that we can ship in our marketplace so our customers can enable the feature without separate provisioning? Key questions:
- Can you support co-branded / white-labeled experience (logo + naming control)?
- What is the expected integration surface (SDK, init flow, redirect vs direct runtime)?
- Commercial models you typically recommend for marketplace distribution (rev-share vs fixed SKU vs metered usage)?
- Any certification or security checklist we should plan for?

I've attached a short requirements doc (atlas_requirements_v1.pdf) that outlines our integration constraints and expected SLAs.

We'd like to run a small pilot with one anchor customer early next year if the terms and integration scope align. Are you available next week for a 30m to walk through the doc?

Best,
Emily Zhao
Director, Platform Partnerships
AtlasWorks

Attachment: atlas_requirements_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlasworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring an in-app plugin for AtlasWorks marketplace

Hi Emily — great to connect. Thanks for the requirements doc, that was helpful context. High-level responses inline and then a proposed next step: 30m sync next Wed (Dec 1) to go through the pilot plan.

Inline:
- White-label: yes — we can support co-branded experiences. There are two flavors: (1) lightweight UI wrapper with your branding that calls hosted Redwood APIs, (2) private runtime bundle you host (VPC/on-prem) for stricter isolation. We can scope either for marketplace distribution.
- Integration surface: we typically offer an embeddable JS runtime that initializes with a short token exchange (2-step init) and exposes the same generation/chat APIs as our hosted API. For marketplace ease, we recommend the hosted path for faster onboarding and to allow automatic updates.
- Commercial models: three typical approaches — revenue share (recommended for low-friction marketplace placements), per-customer SKU (easy to catalog), and metered usage (best for heavy/variable usage). Example starting point: 70/30 rev-share (Redwood/AtlasWorks) for first 12 months of pilot, then re-evaluate.
- Certification/security: we have a partner checklist and can run an abbreviated SOC 2 scoping call. See attached term sheet for the commercial examples I mentioned.

Next steps:
1) Quick partner call to confirm pilot scope & anchor customer (30m).
2) Red team to share partner SOW + security checklist.
3) Legal exchange for a simple partner addendum (rev-share + listing rights).

Attaching a one-page term sheet (redwood-marketplace-plugin-term-sheet.pdf) that maps commercial models to typical integration effort.

I'll book time for Dec 1 if that works — propose 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-plugin-term-sheet.pdf
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlasworks.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring an in-app plugin for AtlasWorks marketplace

Karthik — thanks for the clear options and the term sheet. Quick clarifications before the call:
- Anchor customer for the pilot will be Cobble Labs (they were on the discovery call). They prefer a self-serve enablement flow; rev-share sounds workable if onboarding is < 2 weeks.
- For the hosted path: can you guarantee per-tenant isolation for keys and logs? Our security team will require tenant separation in logs and a simple audit trail for marketplace installs.
- For co-marketing: Cobble Labs would like a joint listing + a short case study after pilot completion — is there a standard co-marketing package?

We can do Dec 1 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Emily

Emily — looping in a short draft SOW and our security checklist so Cobble Labs / AtlasWorks can review before the call.

Key items in the SOW:
- Pilot scope: single anchor tenant (Cobble Labs), 8-week pilot, sandbox + production toggle, metrics collection for latency/cost, roll-out playbook.
- Delivery: Redwood will provide the embeddable JS bundle, partner install guide, and 1 day of co-engineering support for initial enablement.
- Success criteria: active use by anchor tenant, a short co-marketing case study, and a decision on the commercial model by the end of month 2.

Security checklist highlights:
- Tenant isolation for keys/logs (required)
- Minimum TLS + mTLS option for private runtime
- Audit logs exposed via partner portal (read-only)

I've attached partner-sow-draft.docx and security-checklist.xlsx — please let us know any gaps ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Solutions Architect, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Summary of decisions:
- Pilot: Cobble Labs as anchor tenant; 8-week pilot starting Jan 10, 2027 (sandbox week + production week 1 planned).
- Integration: hosted embeddable JS runtime with tenant-key isolation and audit logs exposed to AtlasWorks partner portal.
- Commercial: provisional revenue-share model 65/35 (Redwood/AtlasWorks) for pilot; if usage grows beyond agreed thresholds we'll reprice. Legal to draft a partner addendum (simple rev-share + listing rights).
- Co-marketing: joint listing in AtlasWorks marketplace + one short case study after pilot. Redwood marketing will provide a listing tile and one quote.

Immediate next steps (owners):

- Redwood Solutions (Lauren) to share final SOW and developer install guide (by Dec 6).
